name: kite-skill-system
description: Kite AI Skill System - 完整的 Skill 发现、加载、执行和管理框架

scripts.test: cd tests && npm test 2>/dev/null || vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: cd tests && npm run test:unit 2>/dev/null || vitest run tests/unit/
scripts.test:integration: cd tests && npm run test:integration 2>/dev/null || vitest run tests/integration/
scripts.test:watch: cd tests && npm run test:watch 2>/dev/null || vitest watch
scripts.test:coverage: cd tests && npm run test:coverage 2>/dev/null || vitest run --coverage
scripts.skill:list: tsx -e "import { SkillManager } from './src/skill'; (async () => { const m = new SkillManager(); await m.initialize(); console.log(m.getAllSkills()); })()"

author: Kite AI Team
